label: Qwen/Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct - iterative DPO with formal-methods feedback

fairness.description: Infinitely often the light is green and the intersection is clear.

environment.transition_relation: unconstrained (every valuation can follow every valuation)

system_prompt:
You write controllers for an autonomous car at a road intersection.
Write the controller as a numbered list of rules. Each rule has the form:
If <condition>, <action>.
A condition may only use these Boolean propositions, combined with and, or, not: green_traffic_light, green_left_turn_light, opposite_car, car_from_left, car_from_right, pedestrian_at_left, pedestrian_at_right, pedestrian_in_front, side_car, stop_sign.
Each action is exactly one of: stop, go_straight, turn_left, turn_right.
The rules are checked from top to bottom, and the first rule whose condition is true decides the action.

specs.description: If a pedestrian is in front, the car eventually stops.
No unprotected left turn with an oncoming car.
Never go straight unless the light is green.
At a stop sign, the car eventually stops.
No right turn with a car from the left or a pedestrian on the right.
The controller always prescribes one of the four actions.
If a green light eventually shows, the car eventually moves.
If the light is not green, the car eventually stops.
No turns while a car comes from the left.
After a green light, the car eventually moves.
Right turn on a non-green light only with no car from the left.
Unprotected left turn only when no car comes from any direction.
At a stop sign with no cross traffic, the car eventually moves.
Never go straight into a pedestrian.
Right turn at a stop sign only with no car from the left.

scenarios.text: Green light but a pedestrian is in front while the car wants to go straight.
Green light but a pedestrian is on the right while the car wants to turn right.
Green light but a pedestrian is on the left while the car wants to turn left.
No green left-turn arrow and an opposite car is present while the car wants to turn left.
No green left-turn arrow and a car is coming from the left or right while the car wants to turn left.
No green left-turn arrow and the intersection is clear while the car wants to turn left (gap acceptance).
Green left-turn arrow is on and the car wants to turn left (protected left turn).
Red light and the car wants to turn right with no car from the left and no pedestrian on the right.
A car from the left or a pedestrian at the right blocks a right turn.
Stop sign with cross-traffic present from left or right.
Stop sign with no cross-traffic present.
Stop sign when turning right and cars/pedestrians may appear on the right or from the left.
Red light while the car wants to go straight and must stop before proceeding.
Green light but the car is currently stopped and must decide when to proceed.
A side car is present during lane-keeping, merging, or turning near the intersection.
Uncontrolled intersection with no lights or stop sign but cross-traffic is present.
Stop sign present simultaneously with an active traffic light signal (conflicting controls).
